title: Thursday Night Foot-skills: Rec
desc: Own the ball, beat your defender. Develop the technique, creativity, and confidence to take players on and make an impact in game situations.

details.tagline: More Touches. Better Technique. More Confidence on the Ball.
details.body:
Confidence on the ball starts with quality touches and strong technical habits. This clinic gives players the repetition and freedom to develop their footskills, creativity, and ability to make quick decisions with the ball.

## Training Focus

- Quick touches, tight-space dribbling, and changing direction at speed
- Receiving and controlling the ball cleanly in different situations
- Recognizing when to dribble, combine, or attack space under pressure
- Carrying the ball with control while accelerating and changing direction
